_comment: Quality policy of this instance (dqv:QualityPolicy). Set by the data owner; every change is a commit, so the policy itself is audited. Defaults from the SOFTENG 2026 paper (weights, cutoff) and the qualification (alert bands), plus the Layer 5 extension: integrity factor, evidence validity, interval for partial coverage. See README, section 'How the score works'. unrecorded_change: what bytes that changed with no record in the metadata do to the older evaluation: 'finding' (it still counts, flagged as an earlier version, and cannot reach the cutoff) or 'supersede' (it stops counting).
